function: CSI compression and recovery for downlink feedback in FDD massive MIMO, with adaptation to new scenarios by CSI translation and data augmentation (p. 1, p. 3).
system: FDD massive MIMO downlink, gNB with 32 antennas, single-antenna UEs, OFDM; no RIS; 5.3 GHz, 300 MHz, 2.61 GHz and 2.6 GHz datasets (p. 8).
method: Deep unfolding ISTA network SPTM2-ISTANet+ with trainable measurement matrix; supervised pretraining, then CNN translation module trained on few new samples (transfer); model-driven data augmentation (p. 4, p. 6).
data_channel: COST2100 indoor and outdoor, measured KU Leuven massive MIMO testbed CSI, and QuaDRiGa 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa; 100,000 training and 20,000 test samples per dataset (p. 8).
test_conditions: Pretrain on one of four datasets, test on the other three unseen, directly or with translation module trained on 200 or all samples; SNR mismatch (p. 9, 12).
baselines: CsiNet+, DCRNet, ISTANet+, TiLISTA-Joint, TransNet, STNet; retrained model, direct reuse, one-sided encoder [25]; ChannelGAN and simple augmentations; no classical feedback method (p. 8, 9, 11).
metrics: NMSE and cosine similarity (precoding gain) versus compression ratio; parameters, FLOPs and runtime of encoders and augmentation (p. 8, p. 14).
complexity: Parameters, FLOPs and runtime of UE encoders (SPTM2-ISTANet+ 1.0 M parameters, 2.1 M FLOPs at CR 1/4; translation module 1.8 K parameters, 3.7 M FLOPs) (p. 14).
openness: No code or data released by the authors; uses the public KU Leuven measured CSI dataset (IEEE Dataport doi 10.21227/nr6k-8r78) and COST2100 (p. 8, p. 15).
q1_support: p. 8: "generated using the QuaDRiGa platform [38] based on the 3GPP TR 38.901 urban macrocell (UMa) scenario"; the other datasets come from the COST2100 model and a measured KU Leuven testbed.
q2_support: p. 9: "For each model, we used the other three datasets, unseen by the pretrained model, as new scenarios."; adaptation: "performance of CSI-TransNet with the proposed ADS+PRS augmentation starting with 200 samples from the new scenario".
q3_support: p. 8: "SPTM2-ISTANet+ is evaluated against six established CSI feedback schemes"; all six are learned, no non-learned CSI feedback method is compared, and No Aug, Direct and Retrained are variants of the proposed pipeline.
q4_support: p. 13: "Tables III and IV provide a comparative analysis of parameters and Floating Point Operations (FLOPs)"; Table V gives the runtime (p. 14).
q5_support: p. 8: "This dataset includes CSI samples from the KU Leuven Massive MIMO testbed"; p. 15: "IEEE Dataport, doi: 10.21227/nr6k-8r78" (ref. [37]); the paper releases no code.
notes: Area 2: the learned function is CSI compression, feedback and recovery; the translation module and the augmentation serve it. q3 not met because all six compared schemes are learned and no classical CSI feedback method (compressive sensing, codebook) is evaluated; No Aug, flipping, rotation, Direct and Retrained are variants of the proposed pipeline (p. 8-9), so the reviewer should confirm. q5 rests on the measured KU Leuven dataset with a DOI and the widely used COST2100 data; the authors release no code.
